messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: SLO burn detected for route `/v1/generate` in eu-west — p99 = 3.9s (SLO 1.5s). 389 alerts in 5m. https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/3890456780 :pager:
PagerDuty: PAGE FIRED -> On-call escalation (primary -> Lina). Incident ID PD-2026-3890 :rotating_light:
Lina (oncall): acked the page, jumping in. Starting triage. I'll check recent deploys and model routing.
Lina (oncall): dashboards show tail latency surge at 10:11Z, concurrent retries spiked. Error graphs show model-proxy v2.1.4 error rate up.
Marco (engineer): we did a staged rollout of model-proxy v2.1.4 to eu-west ~10:05Z for a TLS keepalive optimization. Rolling back now looks like a good first step.
Sam (sre): scaling up serving pool and adding extra replicas to absorb traffic while we triage. Running commands now:```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/model-serving-eu --replicas=12
kubectl -n infra rollout undo daemonset/model-proxy --to-revision=3
```
ops-bot: Applied traffic split: eu-west -> fallback-model-quantized-v1 = 100% (temporary) via routing-policy  `rp://eu-west/fallback-temp-3890` :white_check_mark:
Lina (oncall): good — routing fallback in place. Checking logs from model-proxy:```
E 10:12:34 model-proxy: tls renegotiate loop: short read from backend, retrying (count=4)
WARN 10:12:35 connfd 0x7f8a3c: retry backoff, queued requests increasing
```
Marco (engineer): that matches a bug introduced in v2.1.4 where TLS renegotiation triggers a socket leak under high QPS. Reverting was the right call.
PagerDuty: Escalation triggered in 6m -> notifying secondary (Priya).
Priya (oncall-2): acknowledged. I'll take the handoff if Lina needs to step off after stabilization.
Sam (sre): After scale + rollback + routing fallback p95/p99 trends: p95 = 420ms (was 1.1s), p99 = 980ms (was 3.9s) — almost back to normal baseline. Still watching for error spikes.
Lina (oncall): confirm: model-proxy daemonset reverted and pods are in Ready state. Logs show TLS errors stopped after rollback.
Lina (oncall): immediate mitigation summary: 1) rollback model-proxy v2.1.4 -> v2.1.3 2) route eu-west to fallback-model-quantized-v1 3) scale model-serving-eu from 6->12 replicas 4) temp ingress rate-limit relaxed to allow drained requests.
Marco (engineer): plan for next steps: create a patch for TLS renegotiation, add stronger readiness/liveness probes to model-proxy, and add a connection limit guard. I'll open PR and link to incident.
Lina (oncall): opening incident ticket now and assigning follow-ups. Priority: P2.
Lina (oncall): incident timeline note: root trigger appears to be model-proxy v2.1.4 socket leak under TLS renegotiation when QPS > 2500, causing request queueing and retries which amplified tail latency.
Priya (oncall-2): taking post-incident ownership for RCA and will coordinate postmortem. I'll run a replay test on staging with synthetic QPS to confirm fix.
Sam (sre): added temporary alert mute for noisy symptom metrics (suppress repeat pages for 10m) so we don't autopage during mitigation checks:```
/alert mute 3890456780 10m
```
Lina (oncall): handing off live monitoring to Priya — I'm going offline for a scheduled call in 20m. Priya will be point until we close the PD incident. :hand_over:
Priya (oncall-2): acknowledged handoff, will keep watch and escalate if we see regression.
PagerDuty: PAGE AUTO-CLOSE candidate (no new triggers for 12m) — closing if stable.
Lina (oncall): adding quick notes for postmortem: - revert rollback triggered immediate p99 improvement - missing connection-saturation guard in model-proxy - add canary soak threshold for TLS-related kernel changes - improve runbook steps for routing fallback.
Marco (engineer): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/model-proxy/pull/452 (TLS renegotiate fix + probe).
ops-bot: Incident PD-2026-3890 recorded, summary posted to #incidents/3890456780. Follow-ups: owner Marco, due 2026-04-06.
Priya (oncall-2): final status: metrics stable for 18m, p99 back under 1s, no customer escalations in support triage. I'll mark incident as resolved in PD in 30m after final checks.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged -> resolved (auto) by monitoring after 22m without new alerts.
Lina (oncall): thanks team — good coordination. Follow-up actions assigned. :tada:
